balls.text: Low full toss again, swung away wide of long-on and just two runs off it. Just eight runs off the final over. Punjab Kings need 200 to win
Another full toss, Krunal ends up chipping it down the ground and it falls just short of Bairstow coming in from long-on

A bit of a mix-up and Mohsin is run-out. Krunal drives another full toss straight into the non-striker's stumps. Mohsin had taken off for a run after seeing the ball hit the stumps, but Krunal isn't interested. Harshal is quick to collect the ball and uproot one of the stumps
Another low full toss, this time Krunal flays it over cover!
Full toss again, Krunal goes for a big swing and gets a top edge that goes high in the air. Falls short of long-on running in and they get two
Starts off with a low full toss, clipped away to wide long-on. Krunal turns down the single!
Pitched up on the stumps, Mohsin swings it hard down the ground, nearly taking Krunal Pandya's head off! The ball goes to long-on and they get two
Two in two for Curran! Slower ball again, 109kph, dug in short. Bishnoi went for the pull but could only find the deep square leg fielder
Holes out at long-on. Slower ball, full outside off, and Badoni can only lob it up to Bairstow in the deep. He struggled today and falls for 8 off 10. This was bowled at 86kph!
Slower ball, full outside off, Badoni swings it away to deep midwicket
On a length on middle, pulled away through square leg
Slower bouncer, hit up and over short third! Krunal waits on it and uppercuts it hard! Smartly played
Short on leg, pulled away to deep square leg
Driven down the ground for six! On a full length on middle and going across Krunal, who drives it on the up. Long-off was running across but he got enough height on it
Now he fires a full toss well wide of off
Fires a yorker down leg at 140.1kph
Goes for the wide yorker, pitches it maybe just a tad shorter than he needed to, and that's enough for Krunal to thrash a drive through cover. Great shot, that
Bangs it in short outside off. Krunal looks to swivel and pull but it goes over him. Called wide
Full on off, driven down the ground and great fielding at mid-off. He is quick to move to his left and dive to stop it. Would have been four if not for the stop
Full and wide, Krunal goes for a big swing and is lucky that the inside edge goes past off-stump and races away for four
Full on middle and off, driven out to mid-off
Curran goes full on off at 127kph, chipped down the ground safely to long-on
Curran digs it in short at 110kph, Badoni is early into the pull and miscues it to the vacant midwicket region
Full outside off, Badoni looks to swing it down the ground but gets it off the inside edge onto the ground and back to the bowler
Angles a short ball into Krunal from outside off. Krunal swivels and pulls it away to deep midwicket
Slower ball down leg, Badoni waits on it before easing it to backward square leg
Full around middle, swinging in a little surprisingly. Clipped away through square leg
Full on middle, Krunal gets it out through square leg. They only get a single
Short outside off, and dispatched over midwicket! Krunal was cramped for room so he had to play a sort of a short-arm jab, and he plays it oh so well
Krunal gets squared up by a length ball angling in. The ball lobs up off his thigh pad to the point fielder. Rabada has a polite enquiry about a catch, but there was no bat on that
Back of length outside off, punched out through point for a single
Length ball outside off, punches it past the cover fielder to get off the mark

Pooran drags it onto his stumps! Pooran is disgusted with himself. This is full and way wide, Pooran looks for a big shot and ends up getting a big inside edge onto the stumps. That's a massive wicket for Kings. Pooran was looking very deadly!
On a length outside off, punched to cover
Full on leg, driven down the ground to long-on
Hoicked over midwicket! Skips down the track and slogs it away
Eased through midwicket for a single
Pooran looks for a big swing on a length ball around leg and misses. Big appeal but they don't review. That looked like it pitched outside leg
Is that a drop? On a length outside off, Badoni gets a thick inside edge as he looks to cut. The ball hits Jitesh's gloves before he had any time to react though
Short outside leg, Badoni helps it along to long leg
Pitched up outside off, driven to mid-off
Top-edged over the keeper! Back of length outside off, Pooran goes to pull and gets a top edge but there was nothing doing as that goes over Jitesh for four
Length ball, wide of off, Pooran frees his arms and crunches it through cover for a boundary
Length ball angled across Badoni, who steers it out to deep third
And he strikes straightaway! Bangs it in short outside off, de Kock goes for the pull but gets a top edge. Jitesh gets under it and makes no mistake
Played out to deep backward point for a single
On a length outside off and going across, he leaves it alone. A little misfield by the keeper allows them to run the bye
Slower ball yorker, dug out to the off side for a quick single
Full and wide, driven out to deep cover
Full outside off, de Kock squeezes it out to deep backward point
Full and wide, left alone by de Kock as the umpire calls it a wide

Full outside off and going across, de Kock looks to move across and paddle it fine. It goes through fine leg for four. It's given leg byes but a replay shows he gloved it onto his pads. And that means QDK gets his half-century!
On a length around leg, nudged through the leg side for a single. 20 runs off that over
Length ball going across Pooran who pulls it down the ground to long-on
Short and wide and slapped away through cover, but this time the off-side sweeper manages to stop the boundary
Pooran on the charge! Full outside off, Pooran takes one stride forward and muscles it straight down the ground. He has raced to 21 off 10 here
Chahar responds by dropping it shorter and pitching it across Pooran, who makes room and slaps it through cover!
That is very high, and goes far enough! Tossed up full outside off, Pooran has a mighty swing at it over midwicket. Powerful, powerful shot
Full on off, steered through point with an open face
Full around off, punched out to cover
Length ball angling in from outside off, he tucks it through square leg
Back of length outside off, de Kock cuts it hard but straight to backward point
De Kock loses his shape and gets a thick edge, but LSG won't mind the outcome! This is full outside off and QDK went for a big swing. The ball flies over the keeper and races away for four
Back of length ball outside off, Pooran steers it to deep third
Short and wide and de Kock slaps this slower ball between cover and mid-off. QDK has looked real good today
Full ball on le, flicked past a diving midwicket fielder. Long-on runs across to his left to gather
Full around off, punched back to the bowler
Slower ball on a length outside off, punched away to deep point
Length ball outside leg, tucked through fine leg
Starts off with a length ball outside off, slapped away to deep backward point
Tossed up full on the stumps, de Kock works it out to wide long-on
Tossed up slow and full on middle and off, driven out to long-off

Knocks him over! Rahul Chahar bowls this on a length on middle, quicker and flatter. Stoinis went for the pull and missed and the ball went in with the angle to hit leg stump. Just as Stoinis got going, he has to go!
Chahar overcompensates and drags it down. Stoinis clears his front leg and clears the midwicket boundary with that pull! Back-to-back sixes for him
In the slot and Stoinis gets a chance to flex his muscles! Hammers it right down the ground and all the Kings fielders could do was watch it sail over
Full around leg, de Kock eases it towards backward square leg for a quick run
Angles it across de Kock, who frees his arms to slap it away to sweeper cover
On a length around off, Stoinis moves leg-side to make room before hitting it out to the long-on fielder
Length ball outside off, slapped away in front of the sweeper cover fielder for a couple
Full outside off, played back to the bowler
Brar pulls his length back and Stoinis slaps it hard to Dhawan at short cover. Good reflexes to stop a boundary
Lobbed up full around off, driven on the bounce to cover
Full on middle, clipped away straight of deep midwicket and they'll get two
Full on leg, Stoinis eases it through midwicket for a single
Flung full on leg, clipped away through midwicket t the fielder in the deep
Short-ish outside off, punched away to Curran at sweeper cover
Tossed up on middle, Quinton de Kock eases it through midwicket for a single
Legbreak on a length outside off, Stoinis backs away and punches it out to the sweeper cover
Back of length and angling into him, QDK heaves it away in front of square leg and into the stands! Ends the powerplay on a high for LSG
Full and wide, back-of-the-hand slower ball, stays low and beats the bat as QDK throws his bat at it

Just gets it over mid-on running back! QDK doesn't get all of it as he looks to pull a short delivery down the ground. The ball lobs up and it looked like mid-on was in with a chance, but it goes over him
Short of a good length around off, QDK steers it fine of short third, but Rabada is quick there to cut it off
On a length aorund leg, Stoinis parries it through midwicket for a single
Hit straight to mid-off! Padikkal looks to back away and slap this length ball away. He hit it well, he hit it hard, but he hit it too close to Dhawan, who just moves to his right to gobble that up
Beauty! On a full length outside off at 145.9kph, the ball straightens and fizzespast de Kock's bat and through to the keeper
Full outside off, Padikkal looks to drive on the off side and slices it towards Harshal Patel at deep backward point. But the ball lands short of him
Angles a full ball into Padikkal who misses his flick
Neatly played! Length ball angles in towards Padikkal, who opens the face to steer it past the wide slip fielder for four more
Punched over mid-off! This is a length ball outside off, Padikkal hits it on the up and gets enough of it to clear the in-field. Couple of bounces and over the rope
Full outside off, driven uppishly to the deep point fielder
Full length around middle and off, Padikkal defends firmly

Arshdeep has his revenge! Rahul looks to dab away a length ball going across him, opens the face but steers it to Bairstow's left at backward point. The Englishman reacts sharply and sends Rahul packing for a 9-ball 15

Arshdeep goes full on middle and off and Rahul whips it over midwicket. Drops just short of the boundary and stops, so they can only get two! Looks like a slow-ish outfield. Good shot again by KL Rahul
Slower ball, in the slot, and dispatched down the ground for a one-bounce four. He picked the slower ball early and clobbered it down the ground
Arshdeep goes short and across Rahul, who pulls it just short of mid-on
Welcome to the party, KL Rahul! Sees a slot delivery around off, and lofts a drive down the ground for his first six of the day
143kph length ball outside off, jags in sharply as QDK looks to cut. The ball sneaks under the bat to beat him. Great delivery
Length ball angled into de Kock, who parries it leg side

What. A. Shot! Length ball outside off, QDK opens the face and drives off the back foot and it goes high over the backward point boundary. Shades of that SKY drive behind point for six against Gujarat Titans at the Wankhede last year
Slashed over point for a one-bounce four!
Dug in short, he miscues a pull to midwicket

Almost gets Rahul first ball! Rahul sees a length ball angling in and goes for the pickup shot. This came to him at hip height and he doesn't get it all that well. Harshal Patel is running in from the deep square boundary and dives in front, and for a moment it looks like he's caught a blinder, but it pops out of his hands
Slashed over short third! Sees some width and throws his hands at it, does de Kock. Gets a thick edge that takes it past the infield but deep backward point stops the boundary
136kph full delivery swinging into Rahul's pads, who tucks it out to deep backward square
Length ball outside off, chopped away to deep third
Pitched up outside off, de Kock drives it down to mid-off
Full outside off, swinging in, Rahul tucks it out through square leg off the inside half of the bat
Full, but swings in too much to go down leg
In the air! But goes wide of the point fielder! Slower ball, full outside off, draws the drive from de Kock, but he gets an edge that goes to Chahar's right
On a full length outside off, swinging into Rahul, who taps it towards backward point
Short of good length outside off, QDK nudges it through the leg side for a single
Gorgeous drive to get going! Full outside off, swinging away just a smidge, de Kock meets it with the full face of the bat, driving it straight of mid-off
Pitched up fuller and close to off stump, de Kock defends watchfully under his eyes
Fuller side of good length, hint of shape away, de Kock shoulders arms
Starts off with a good length ball just outside off, QDK looks to block and gets an inside edge onto his pads
Makes room and slaps the slow length ball on fourth, to deep point
Clothed, lands safely and goes to Bishnoi at deep-mid. Livingstone yelps in pain, hobbles the run, lunges and collects a breath. Was a wide length ball that was heaved across
Back of length over fifth, Livingstone has a swipe across. Misses
Very wide but flat-batted down the ground. Released from very wide of the crease, shortish too, not sure how Livingstone middled that. Magical almost
Not fun being an Afghanistan bowler against a batter who can't walk. He goes wide and full, it's not in his reach as such, but he's able to reach out and flay it over extra
Length on middle and off, back is bent across in advance. He swings across the line and gets six over square leg
Another bumper but it's slower and bounces over head. Beats the pull
Wide yorker, slapped to deep cover. 41 needed off 6, so the game's done
Wide on a length, Liam goes across and slaps it down the ground. Mid-off was very straight and in but was cleared, long-off was too wide
Bumper outside off, beats Livingstone's cut but QDK's reflexes are tested. He manages to take it and then has a word with the bowler
Wide yorker, squeezed to deep backward point
Goes across and gets followed by a length ball. Lap-swept onto the body and then to short fine leg
Wide on a length, just inside the tramline. Let go, wide rightly not called. 102ks
Clips the length ball to the legside

Slower one goes under the bat swing. Smart from LSG to keep it outside Livingstone's arc, something Afghanistan didn't do against Maxwell in the WC. Length ball on sixth, Livingstone tried to go over midwicket
Fullish and slow, attempted slog plinked again. Leg-side single again
Slow on a slot length but it's on fifth stump. Livingstone has to reach out with upper body only, which is not enough, for the slog over midwicket. Inside edges it to the leg side
Pacy bouncer around off, doesn't get the pull this time. Goes off the body to the offside

Bishnoi runs swiftly to the right but can't stop it. Charged from deep midwicket but the ball kept going away and landed a foot or two behind as he slid into the grass. Was a slow short ball that was pulled
Run-out chance missed, no direct hit from point. But Livingstone hobbling is the bigger story. He'd given up too but Stoinis can't get it. Was a length ball outside off that was pushed gently
Bumper on fifth, pulled to deep midwicket. Limited timing, not sure how freely Livingstone's feet are moving
Hat-trick ball is into the pitch, just outside off, tapped to the offside with a fully open face

Pull skied, catch taken at mid-on, Mohsin has two in two. Another slower bumper, just under shoulder-height just outside off, Curran tried leathering the pull but got a top edge. No sighters and no second chances - death overs doing its thing

Bumper is tickled to the keeper. Dhawan can't close out the chase. This landed around fourth, Dhawan swung his head outside off and tried to hook it almost, feathered it to QDK, who wasn't fazed by the dipping ball and took a good catch to the left. Dhawan ends with a SR of 140 but I'd say it's hard to blame him for not going harder during the Mayank's whirlwind spell
Deep point runs to the left but can't get there. Bishnoi it is, does well to get body behind the ball and get it on the bounce. Was a shortish ball that was slashed
Goes back to a 148ks length ball on off, cloths a slog. Gets it to deep midwicket.
Ooh, misses a slot ball! 151ks though, three-quarter length but that's slot in T20ks, especially for guys like Liam. He's across on off and tries slugging over midwicket

141ks, Another pull us ballooned, Naveen takes another catch. Short into the pitch, rises around rib-height, Jitesh looked to go over midwicket but like a few other team-mates, got hurried. Naveen went from mid-on towards short midwicket to catch the top edged ball
Another cut beaten, 148ks. Shortish just outside off, Jitesh tries cutting behind square
Stays in the crease while shuffling across, gets followed by a very full ball at 153ks. Must've been an inside edge as he tried whipping it, deflects away off the pad
Dhawan goes across and a low full toss is further from him, guided to deep point
Slower one goes under bat. Length on fifth, 115ks, Jitesh swipes across the line before collapsing
Slow and into the pitch, shortish, pulled to deep-backward square

First review of the match is for a wide that's been given. Dhawan goes across, back leg is on fourth stump and he tries to heave the back-of-length ball over fine leg. He's inside the line of the ball, it's a tad down leg but not enough to be an extra
Wide on a length, Jitesh goes across and guides it to deep third
Wide and fullish, angle takes it past the bat swing. Wide given. 139ks. Jitesh tried slapping it over cover
Wide yorker, around sixth stump, 140ks, Jitesh tries walking into a cover drive. Beaten
Makes room and thumps it down the ground. It's fullish, Jitesh turned it into a half-volley and clobbered it straight of long-on. Kings have been proactive
Mayank knows the instruction and follows it to the T again. 143ks shortish and over off, guided to deep third.
Let go. Early 140ks, shortish over off, Jitesh shapes ever so slightly for the ramp but has no intention of playing it
Sniff-the-leather stuff. 145ks, shortish and goes right past him. Let go

Ballooned pull to mid-on, 147ks. Short and over midde, rose around rib-height, Prabhsimran cleared the front leg and tried forcing it but clothed it straight to Naveen. Pace doing pace things. Good cameo from the batter though

Mohsin is tangled up on the deep-backward-point boundary falls over the toblerone! 149ks, just outside off, Prabhsimran backed away and was crouching (prolly in reflex) but swung through anyway. The top edge off the cut went high, fielder ran to the right but couldn't keep it in
Goes across and real far back, helps the hard-length ball to deep fine leg

Don't think he middled the slog sweep but it cleared long-on anyway. 104ks but overpitched. Just outside off, Prabhsimran got on one knee and got it off the bottom-quarter of the bat but it sailed 78 metres far.
Length on off, pushed to coer with the fully open bat face
Clips the length ball to midwicket
Cannoned down the ground. 103ks, length on fifth, Prabhsimran had a free swing. Step-hit too, which is what the batters want in T20s
Stays leg side and whacks a sweep to deep midwicket
Driven to deep cover
Dhawan uses the pace again. Gets it on top of the bounce and guides it wide of short third. Not that bad a ball, channel line, decent length but the batter
Length on fourth, 153ks, chopped to the offside

Mayank's pace breaks the partnership 143ks. Bairstow started making room and Mayank followed him, went into the pitch, found the top edge off the pull. Was a length ball on top of leg, Bairstow was deep in the crease and was hurried despite seeming to have planned the shot in advance. Ball sailed three-fourth of the way out, Stoinis ran in and took a sliding catch
142ks, looks just as pacy. Bairstow was making room and tried to ramp/upper cut it. Gets nothing on it
Done for pace again but Dhawan gets away with the top edge. 149ks, shortish and around off, Dhawan tried forcing the pull, it balloons over the bowler
Yoo, 155ks! Dhawan makes room and tries to slap it square, misses
Great pace off the pitch again. Fuller side of length on fifth, Bairstow still goes for the cut, misses again
Length ball lands on fourth and zips past the attempted cut
Flat googly on off, stays leg side and square drives it. Very little room there
Length outside off, guided to the point

No direct hit and that saves Bairstow! He wasn't in the frame but Siddharth, who ran in from deep square and threw it flat at the non-striker's end, missed the mark. Might be marked as a half-chance on scoring.
Length outside off, 98ks, gets on one knee and steers it to backward point
Length just outside off, guided to deep third
Uses the pace and the line being a bit too straight. On the pads, 148ks, the length ball is clipped to the long-leg boundary
Chops the length ball outside off to point
Makes room, gets followed and cramped. Bairstow tried to clip the 150ks length ball with a closed bat-face while on the move, beaten

Nails the cut this time. Shorter ball, same line, 146ks, Bairstow clears the front leg, stays legside of the ball and deep in the crease, slaps it not for from deep-backward point, who nonetheless had no chance
Pace yaar, 147ks, length on fifth, Bairstow tries to cut hard. Misses
Shortish on fifth, cut to deep-backward point
Low fullt outside off, 111ks, helped around to long leg
Goes across after backing away initially. Krunal slows it, keeps it fullish and outside off. Dhawan tried sweeping it but got it off the bottom-half of bat onto pad
Length outside off, chopped to deep point
Krunal misses the length and gets slog swept again. Much easier for Bairstow as this was fuller, still happy to take it from middle stump, deposited over midwicket for a 93-metre six
Bairstow doesn't allow Krunal to get into the over. Not that bad a ball, length at middle, but he went on one knee and powered it square. Seemed a case of a risk coming off for the batter
Goes for another full-fledged reverse. This was shortish and angling away, not far from the tramline. Dhawan, like before, shifted his stance completely but not grip
Another googly, very wide, Dhawan tries chasing and cutting, misses
Slog swept. Picked the bones out of it. Dhawan brings up fifty. Raises his bat. Was full around off, bit over 100ks
Bishnot sees him back away and follows him with a short ball. 100ks, pulled to deep-backward square
Slower. Looped on a full length just outside off, swept to deep square leg
Starts with a quick ball. Fullish outside off, 103ks, driven to cover
Good over from Pandya. Kept the stumps in play and held his length. This was around leg and got tucked to midwicket
Slower on a length, lands around off and straightens a bit, chopped to deep point
More of a dart. Length on middle, worked back to the bowler
Length on leg, clipped off the back foot to deep midwicket. 89ks

Given air, 91ks, gets an underedge. Landed in line with off and got good bounce, Bairstow backed away - kept the back leg in the crease - and tried to steer it with a cross bat. Gets a single to short fine leg luckily
Fullish on off, defended to the bowler
Back of a length just outside off, plinks a cut towards point. Quick run taken. Kings' 61-run powerplay has led to LSG taking an early timeout
Uppish but safe. Pacy ball gets extra bounce. Into a length and Dhawan tried to tuck it to the legside but the ball pops off the outer-half of the bat, ball rolls to mid-on
Slower one is picked up. The cutter was shortish and sat up, spun in towards the waist and Dhawan pulled it over forward square leg for a 79-metre six. Played from inside the crease again
Length around off, punched to the bowler's right

Fifth-stump line and it's too much room, that's how good Dhawan is. Stands in front of middle and off, doesn't move much, waits for the ball to get in line with him, maybe a bit further back, and square drives it behind point
Dhawan makes room, Mohsin sees him and goes wider, but the back of lengther sits up. Cut from deep in the crease, over backward point for a two-bounce four
Length around sixth, underedges a cut, towards cover point
Top edges the pull but gets it safely around the corner. Another slow shortish ball, Dhawan swivelled and pulled out the power from the shot. Stopped at deep fine leg
Shortish and into the body, just 105ks, clipped towards midwicket. Bairstow had to check his shot
Tad fuller than length on fourth, Dhawan tries to clobber it across the line but the bat turns in the hand. It rolls to square leg
Charges, slashes and misses. Naveen probably saw Dhawan, angled it away off a full length. Ball landed around off and went through sixth. A square slash was attempted
Length just outside off, 138ks, pushed with an open face towards cover for a quick single
Length in the channel, true bounce. Chopped late, finds short third
Length around off, punched to the bowler

Is that a run-out chance missed? Mohsin ran in follow-through to his diagonal left, got low and underarmed it in one motion - the angle was in his favour too - but he couldn't get the direct hit. Was an into-the-pitch ball that was tucked gently. Batters took off right away but it was tight.
Tries to pull it again, ball doesn't bounce as much and he gets hit
Helped along, flat six! 134ks on a shortish length, rose to just above waist-height. Step-hit for YJB,
Back of length, defended off the back foot

Oh, that's not Bairstow, just Dhawan reversing. He gripped the bat really firmly, went into motion right after Siddharth released it. Got the full length and a bit of room he was looking for, lifted it behind point for a 60-metre six
Length on the outer half of the pads, 103ks, sharp angle. Helped to short fine
Dhawan plays him like a medium pacer almost. Not much follow-through but the bat swing is power-packed. Was full and wide, he slapped it over mid-off
Dhawan's ready for the length ball being darted in. Was a bit too straight, so he could help it away behind square with the sweep
Underedge. Akeal Hosein-like one-finger flicker from Siddharth, the length ball was wide, so Bairstow tried slashing it square. Luckily it went wide of the keeper
Looked slowish to the eye but it's 98ks. Length ball turns in towards fourth, worked to square leg
Overpitched. Fifth stump and Bairstow didn't have to move. Just waited till he could lunge a bit and cream it through cover
Stays leg side and square drives a length ball darting in towards off stump. Scrambled seam and wide of the crease but the batter is happy to cut the angle
Slower and fullish, tries the on-drive but gets it squarer due to the edge
Shortish and over middle, Bairstow tries pulling with buckled elbows. Gets tucked up, deflects to the offside. I didn't hear anything but there might have been an edge
Fullish on the pads, 137ks, clipped to to deep square leg
Wide of the crease of course. Length on leg, beats the flick and driblles off the pad to the right of the keeper
Length around fourth, 98ks, bunt-pulled to midwicket
Outside edge, goes wide of the diving short-third fielder. Very full and wide, swerves away in the air again, Dhawan tried to drive through cover
A bit slower. On a length outside off, spins back in towards fifth, punched defensively to cover
Length on sixth, drifts (swings?) away a bit. Beats the attempted cover drive
Similar, very flat ball, steered to the same area
Length outside off, chopped to backward point
